defects.title: Header overflows at 768–820px on every page (search bar could not shrink; account labels too wide)
defects.root_cause: Search wrapper/input lacked min-w-0; account text shown from md
defects.fix: min-w-0 on search; account labels from lg; category selector lg+

defects.title: Search bar 'All Categories' control was dead (no handler)
defects.fix: Real category select; searches within category via /products?category=&q=

defects.title: /account overflowed 768–1280px
defects.root_cause: flex-1 without min-w-0; profile card fixed 180px stats from md; 6-col grid from lg
defects.fix: min-w-0, stats row from xl, 6-col grid from 2xl

defects.title: /checkout and /categories overflowed at 1024px
defects.root_cause: Main column missing min-w-0; 380px summary; p-16 hero
defects.fix: min-w-0, 340px summary at lg, responsive padding

defects.title: Phone: cart item name squeezed to 1 letter; search button clipped; hero arrows covered subtitle; order tracker labels merged
defects.root_cause: No-wrap flex rows / fixed padding / arrows over text
defects.fix: Wrapped cart row, min-w-0 search, arrows md+, compact tracker labels

defects.title: Phone/tablet: no product filters, no account navigation; card actions hover-only
defects.root_cause: Sidebars hidden below lg; opacity-0 until hover
defects.fix: Filter drawer + Filters button; account menu strip; actions visible below lg

defects.title: Invisible decorative elements blocked clicks (listing Sort/Filters row); footer link under Premium banner; order pagination under banner
defects.root_cause: Absolute blobs in non-positioned containers; h-full banner overflow; uncapped pagination
defects.fix: relative + pointer-events-none on blobs; removed h-full; compact pagination

defects.title: Address form & contact info forced 2 columns on phones
defects.fix: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2

defects.title: Website shows 'Failed to fetch' / JSON parse errors / backend internals
defects.root_cause: api.ts threw raw fetch/res.json errors and passed any server message
defects.fix: api.ts ApiError + friendlyError normalization; global ErrorDialogHost + showErrorDialog in contact, checkout, addresses, profile, tracking

defects.title: Offers page: invented bank offers with HDFC/ICICI/SBI/Kotak logos, fake tab counts, fake countdown, fake 'chillFi Premium', '80% OFF' claim, dead buttons
defects.fix: Removed bank offers/tabs/premium; hero honest with working Shop Now; sidebar links to real listings; coupon wording fixed

defects.title: Website claims '24/7 support' in 9 places while contact hours are 9 AM–9 PM
defects.fix: Copy updated

defects.title: Contact details inconsistent/placeholder: website +91 98765 43210 & '123 Green Park Society, Indiranagar, Bengaluru' vs app +91 90562 24993
defects.fix: Needs the real business phone/email/address from owner

defects.title: Header 'Brands' ignored (showed all products); 'Best Sellers' actually rating sort
defects.fix: Brands → brands section; renamed Top Rated

defects.title: Fake flash-sale countdown (2h45m reset every load); hardcoded 'Verified Buyer' on testimonials
defects.fix: Timer only with real end date; label removed

defects.title: ~25 dead/fake controls: premium banner, refer & earn, wallet/coins, fake bank offers, fake map/address, support search, FAQ without answers, share wishlist, buy again, invoices, newsletter fake success, invented About stats
defects.fix: Wired to real pages or removed (helper agent + review)
defects.retest: tsc OK; deadscan clean for rendered files

defects.title: Registration accepted invalid email; login panel claimed member-only deals / faster delivery
defects.fix: Web + API validation; honest copy

defects.title: PRICING: cart always 'Free' delivery & total without GST; checkout offered ₹79 Express the server never charged; GST shown before coupon (server after) → displayed ≠ charged
defects.fix: Cart uses live settings; Express removed; GST after coupon; MRP breakdown; backend honours free_shipping_enabled

defects.title: Order success claimed 'Payment Confirmed' for COD, SMS tracking link and '3–5 days' (none exist)
defects.fix: Pay on Delivery vs Paid; honest delivery text

defects.title: Orders search only searched current page; 'Delivered on —' always; fake 'Download Invoices'; 'Support Tickets' (no system)
defects.fix: Server search param; real delivered/expected dates; removed/renamed

defects.title: Shipping Policy promised pincode serviceability check at checkout — none existed (orders to undeliverable pincodes accepted, COD offered where unavailable); summary failure = endless spinner; policy named unused 'Shiprocket'
defects.fix: GET /api/shipping/pincode/:pin (cached, rate-limited, Delhivery); web + app checkout block/disable COD; createOrder guard (only definitive 'no' blocks); retry state; policy text

defects.title: Breadcrumbs used <a href> (full page reload); legal links on Login/Contact/Delete forms navigated away losing typed data; stale © years
defects.fix: Router Links; legal links open in new tab; dynamic year

defects.title: Product listing showed 'No products found' when the API failed/offline
defects.fix: Error state + Try again

defects.title: Two wishlists: header/cards used browser-local list, PDP & app used server → badge wrong, app wishlist invisible on web; logout left previous user's cart/wishlist in browser
defects.fix: Store mirrors server wishlist when logged in (refresh after PDP toggle); logout clears cart+wishlist

defects.title: Checkout 'Add address' silently did nothing on missing/invalid fields and swallowed API errors
defects.fix: Inline validation + friendly API error

defects.title: Promo banner copy says 'Use code FREESHIP' but no such coupon exists (free delivery ≥₹499 is automatic)
defects.fix: Edit the promo banner text in Admin → Promo Banners (content owner)
